statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], p a natural number, V an open of Y, and a:M→N a map of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let I and J be arbitrary injective resolutions of M and N [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Define b_I by the real construction higherDirectImageResolutionSectionMap: isoRightDerivedObj for sections on f⁻¹V [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], then the exact evaluation mapHomologyIso for the presheaf complex underlying f_*I, then sectionCohomologyTheta [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], then evaluation of the inverse isoRightDerivedObj for f_*. Define b_J the same way. Then R^pΓ(f⁻¹V,a) followed by b_J equals b_I followed by Γ(V,R^p f_*(a)). This is a fixed equality of specified maps, not existence of an unspecified comparison.

proof.text: Choose Mathlib's augmentation-preserving lift g = InjectiveResolution.desc a J I, with desc_commutes_zero. Apply isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality to openModuleSections on the inverse-image open; this gives the source resolution square.

Use ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality for exact evaluation of the underlying direct-image presheaf complex. Prove the theta square in the private helper sectionCohomologyTheta_naturality: the generic private adjoint_homology_naturality combines ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality with the homology map of the counit naturality square, then applies Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_square. Specialize its exact left adjoint to PresheafOfModules.sheafification and its right adjoint to forgetting the sheaf condition. Evaluate the resulting theta square at V.

Apply isoRightDerivedObj_inv_naturality to moduleDirectImage, then apply forgetting to presheaves and evaluation at V. Unfold the specified higherDirectImageResolutionSectionMap and combine the source, evaluation, theta, and target squares using associativity. The last identification is definitional: sections of the module direct image on V are sections on the inverse-image open. The proof uses no vanishing, degree restriction, or nonemptiness assumption, and therefore includes p = 0 and empty opens.

lean.statement:
theorem higherDirectImage_resolution_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)} (a : M ⟶ N)
    (I : InjectiveResolution M) (J : InjectiveResolution N) :
  ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).rightDerived p).map a ≫
      higherDirectImageResolutionSectionMap f p V J =
        higherDirectImageResolutionSectionMap f p V I ≫
        ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p ⋙
          RingedSpace.openModuleSections Y.toRingedSpace V).map a
